title: tc-agent-ledger
description: Everything an agent changed, newest first, each change with an Undo that takes what builds on it along.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

agent.description: Who made the changes – e.g. "Launch agent"

entries.description: The changes the agent made, in any order – the ledger lists them newest first

now.description: The clock for "2m ago", in epoch ms – unset, the element keeps its own clock

pointAt.description: Lights up a change and what builds on it, as if its Undo were pointed at – e.g. for a walkthrough

action.description: What was done, in a few words – e.g. "Changed price"

system.description: Where – e.g. "Stripe"; shown after the time and in the labels

change.description: Before and after – e.g. ["$29", "$34"]; or a single line of detail

reversible.description: False for changes that can't be taken back – a sent email, a payout (default true)

dependsOn.description: Ids of the changes this one builds on – undoing one of those undoes this one too
